title: Twelve More Issuers Lift OKXICE Objections to 50
description: OKXICE's October 30 notice adds 12 issuers, including Nvidia, Nike, Costco and Reddit, increasing objections to its proposed tokenized-stock venue from 38 to 50.
why_it_matters: The 32% increase since the prior notice further narrows OKXICE's proposed roster and shows how issuer-level opt-outs can shape which tokenized equities reach a venue.
keyTakeaways: OKXICE's October 30 notice lists 50 objecting issuers, up from 38 in the October 28 version.
The 12 additions include Nvidia, Nike, Costco, Reddit, CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks.
The objections apply to unaffiliated third-party tokens on OKXICE, not every form of stock tokenization.
OKXICE remains a prospective venue; SEC listing does not establish compliance with the exemption's conditions.
body:
OKXICE's public notice dated October 30 lists 50 issuers that objected to tokenized trading of their shares on the proposed venue. The October 28 version listed 38. The 12 additions are CrowdStrike, Corning, Micron Technology, IREN, USA Rare Earth, Bloom Energy, Nike, Nvidia, Palo Alto Networks, Costco, Reddit and Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

The objections concern unaffiliated third-party tokenized NMS stocks offered through OKXICE under the SEC's temporary Innovation Exemption. They block the affected instruments from this venue; they do not prohibit issuer-sponsored tokenization or separate arrangements elsewhere. OKXICE describes a permissioned market using stablecoin pairs and one-for-one share backing, but the notice provides no launch date or reasons for the individual objections. The SEC separately cautions that listing a prospective venue does not establish that it satisfies the exemption's conditions.

sources.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — Innovation Exemption venue notices

facts.claim: OKXICE dated its revised public notice October 30, 2026.
The revised notice identifies 50 issuers that submitted objections.
Nvidia and Nike appear among the newly added issuers.
Costco and Reddit also appear in the October 30 objection list.
A prospective venue must publish its notice at least 30 days before operating.
SEC inclusion does not establish that a venue meets the exemption conditions.
